evals.name: html-report
evals.prompt: I just pulled this year's Journal Impact Factors into jcr_if_2025.json. My journal list is target_journals.json and my multi-year history is jcr_if_database.json (all in this folder). Make me a single-file HTML report of the 2025 numbers, and call out the journals with the biggest year-over-year IF changes.
assertions: Report contains 2025 IF values for the journals (e.g. Nat. Energy ~70.1)
Report shows year-over-year (2024->2025) movers, gainers and losers
HTML is self-contained (no broken external image/file references)

evals.name: trend-plot
evals.prompt: Here's my multi-year journal Impact Factor database (jcr_if_database.json) and my journal list (target_journals.json). Plot the long-run IF trend over all the years in the data and highlight the journals whose IF changed the most.
assertions: Produces a PNG (or image) trend plot
X-axis spans the full year range present in the data (1997-2025), not a hard-coded stop
Some journals are visually highlighted vs gray context lines
Title/axis reflect Impact Factor over years

evals.name: sid-guidance
evals.prompt: I want to pull this year's Journal Impact Factors from JCR (jcr.clarivate.com) with a script, but I keep getting 401 Unauthorized. What exactly do I need to give the script -- what token, and where do I find it in my browser?
assertions: Identifies the needed header as x-1p-inc-sid
Says to copy it from the POST request to .../bwjournal/v1/search-result on jcr.clarivate.com
Warns against the snowplow/analytics request and/or correlation-id confusion
Mentions institution network + token being short-lived/expiring
